title: osmanthus ilicifolius var. myrtifolius
intro: Osmanthus ilicifolius var. myrtifolius, commonly known as the Fragrant Olive or Osmanthus, is a deciduous shrub native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the mind and body, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Osmanthus ilicifolius var. myrtifolius include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
